In this sitdown interview, I grill a Christian Pastor, Joel Webbon, on why he is not a Zionist. He shares how Zionism came to be, how it’s an ideology that tries to hijack theology, and what it’s agenda is and how Israel is using it as a weapon. His knowledge on it is met by my self-righteous, ill informed skepticism.
title: Why Zionism is Great! (Confronting a Christian Pastor)
